_instructions: Active context in JSON mode. The writing agent reads this before writing each chapter, and updates it after. This is the continuity thread between chapter-writing subagents. motif_register, genre_beat_tracker, character_arc_position, and next_chapter_genre_beat are updated after each chapter is written. The writing agent reads these before drafting to confirm motif cadence, genre beat obligation, and character emotional entry state. motif register source: theme.json. beat tracker source: synopsis.json genre_architecture.mandatory_beat_sequence. arc position source: characters.json and outline.json.
title: Working title

chapters_completed.title: Chapter title
chapters_completed.key_achievement: One sentence: what this chapter accomplished narratively

continuity_notes: Concrete facts established that must carry forward — injuries, items used or lost, information revealed, relationship shifts, promises made, specific details named (addresses, dates, names of minor characters)
pending_details: Things seeded but not yet resolved — the outline or earlier chapters set these up but they haven't paid off yet
edits_needed: Inconsistencies discovered during writing — character details that contradict the character file, continuity errors, timeline problems

motif_register.last_appeared: Chapter N or null if not yet appeared
motif_register.register: physical | sensory | behavioral | verbal | absent — the register it last appeared in
motif_register.due_next: Chapter N | overdue | not yet due
motif_register.notes: Brief note on how it appeared or why it is overdue

genre_beat_tracker.chapter: Chapter number where delivered, or null

character_arc_position.character: Character name — must match a name in characters.json
character_arc_position.current_arc_state: One sentence describing their emotional/psychological state at the current story position
character_arc_position.next_arc_milestone: What must happen next for this character's arc to advance

next_chapter_genre_beat: The next undelivered mandatory beat name, or null if all beats delivered

canon_register._instructions: Canonical facts extracted after each chapter. A canonical fact is any concrete, durable truth that must remain consistent in all future chapters. Categories: character_physical, character_knowledge, character_capability, world_fact, magic_rule, timeline, relationship_state, object_state. Append after each chapter — never overwrite existing entries.
canon_register.fact: One sentence stating the canonical truth
canon_register.category: character_physical | character_knowledge | character_capability | world_fact | magic_rule | timeline | relationship_state | object_state
characters: Character names this fact applies to, or empty array if world/system fact
